english.title: Environment Agency fail to ensure water discharged under s163 free of pollution etc
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the appropriate agency, failed to take all necessary steps to secure that water discharged by you under section 163 of the Water Resources Act 1991 was as free as reasonably practicable from mud and silt; solid, polluting, offensive or injurious substances; and substances prejudicial to fish or spawn, or to spawning beds or food of fish
english.legislation: Contrary to section 163(3) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
